title: 第11章 感谢麻显阳大哥送的精铁鱼竿一杆第12章 梅霜风
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 内院，膳房。
冯小保通禀后，引着沈修寒来至此处，随手指了只木盆：
“便搁这里吧。对了，你这篓中几尾鱼，作价几何？”
沈修寒拱手一笑：
“麻大哥昨日交代过，皆按二十五文一斤结算。”
“二十五文…那便依三师弟的意思。”
沈修寒掀开鱼篓，探手捞出三条四纹渔获。
冯小保定睛一瞧，和善的眉头骤然拧起，声音也沉下去：
“怎地全是四纹货色？”
“昨日我特地问过掌勺师傅，言道这银纹鱼，背上纹路越繁，鱼肉便愈发鲜美！”
“莫不是…你听闻我冯某人嗜食鱼货，便妄图以次充好，来诓骗我的银钱？”
沈修寒心中一凛，这冯小保变脸之快，犹如翻书，险些让他乱了阵脚。
但他反应亦是极快，将手中半截断竿举起来，面露苦笑：
“冯大哥明鉴。”
“在下也想多钓几尾上等银纹鱼，奈何今日时运不济。”
“只得了这三尾四纹的不说，好不容易守到一条大鱼，非但没能钓上来，反将我这竹竿生生拉断了！”
“在下恐银纹鱼搁久了不新鲜，顾不上重制钓竿，急急将这三尾送来…冯大哥若是不信，且看这断口，可是簇新的。”
冯小保目光如炬，直直盯着那断口处，审视半晌。
忽然，横肉丛生的脸上阴霾尽扫，仰头大笑起来：
“哈哈哈原来如此，算你有心，倒是我错怪你了！”
笑罢，他眼珠子一转，似是想起了什么，一拍大腿：
“我好食鱼，一日不食便惦记得紧，正好…”
“我那三师弟近来痴迷渔事，置办了几杆上等钓竿，你且在此稍候，我去挑一根来与你使！”
说罢，他一转身，一阵风似的去了。
沈修寒嘴巴微张，半晌回不过神来。
麻显阳沉迷钓鱼，还买了不少鱼竿？
怕是为冲破“练血”桎梏，不仅在外头广布眼线收鱼，还妄图亲自钓出宝鱼来吧！
思索间，脚步声去而复返。
冯小保风风火火跨进门来，手里赫然多了一杆通体幽黑、精铁打就的上品钓竿！
竿身乌沉沉泛着寒光，其上缠绕着蚕丝绞线，末端还配着一整套精钢倒刺明钩。
“喏，先借与你使！”
“拿了趁手的家什，往后务必多给武馆钓些好鱼上来！”
沈修寒接过鱼竿，只一掂量，便知是难得的好货。
鱼竿末尾处，还雕刻了四个小字：白氏钓坊。
白家掌控着西市鱼栏大部分生意，同时也制作、出售各类精良钓竿、渔网、船支。
content_en:
Inner courtyard, dining room.
After Feng Xiaobao informed him, he led Shen Xiuhan here and pointed at a wooden basin:
"Just leave it here. By the way, how many fish are in your basket, and what's the price?"
Shen Xiuhan cupped his hands and smiled:
"Brother Ma told me yesterday that the settlement will be twenty-five cents per catty."
"Twenty-five articles... then it will be according to the wishes of the third junior brother."
Shen Xiuhan opened the fish basket and fished out three four-striped fish.
Feng Xiaobao took a closer look, his kind brows suddenly wrinkled, and his voice deepened:
"How come they are all four-patterned goods?"
"Yesterday I specifically asked the chef who was in charge of the dish, and he said that the more lines on the back of this silver-striped fish, the more delicious the fish will be!"
"Could it be that...you heard that I, Mr. Feng, like to eat fish, so you tried to defraud me of my money by passing it off as good quality?"
Shen Xiuhan's heart trembled. Feng Xiaobao's face changed so quickly, it was like turning the pages of a book, almost making him confused.
But he reacted very quickly. He raised the half-broken pole in his hand and smiled bitterly:
"Brother Feng Mingjian."
"I also want to catch a few more high-quality silver striped fish, but my luck is not good today."
"Not to mention the three tails and four stripes, I managed to catch a big fish. Not only did I fail to catch it, but it broke my bamboo pole!"
"I'm afraid that the silver-striped fish will be stale after being left for a long time, so I didn't bother to remake the fishing rod, so I hurriedly sent these three fish... If Brother Feng doesn't believe it, look at the fracture, it's brand new."
Feng Xiaobao's eyes were as bright as a torch, and he stared at the fracture, examining it for a long time.
Suddenly, the gloom on his fleshy face disappeared, and he raised his head and laughed:
"Hahaha, that's it. Even if you have good intentions, I made the mistake of blaming you!"
After laughing, he rolled his eyes, seemed to remember something, and patted his thigh:
"I like to eat fish. If I don't eat for a day, I will miss it. It's just right..."
"My third junior brother is obsessed with fishing recently and has purchased some high-quality fishing rods. Just wait here while I pick one for you to use!"
After that, he turned around and left like a gust of wind.
Shen Xiuhan's mouth opened slightly, and he couldn't recover for a long time.
Ma Xianyang is addicted to fishing and bought a lot of fishing rods?
I'm afraid that in order to break through the shackles of "blood training", I not only spread my eyes outside to collect fish, but also tried to catch the precious fish myself!
While thinking, the footsteps came and went.
Feng Xiaobao stepped through the door in a hurry, and in his hand was a high-grade fishing rod that was completely black and made of fine iron!
The pole body was dark and shimmering with cold light, and it was wrapped with twisted silk threads, and the end was equipped with a set of fine steel barbed hooks.
"Here, let me lend it to you first!"
"After taking advantage of the household items, I must catch more good fish for the martial arts school in the future!"
Shen Xiuhan took the fishing rod and after just weighing it, he knew it was a rare good product.
At the end of the fishing rod, there are four small characters engraved: Bai's Fishing House.
The Bai family controls most of the business in the West Market Fish Bar, and also manufactures and sells various types of fine fishing rods, fishing nets, and boats.
title_en: Chapter 11 Thanks to Brother Ma Xianyang for the fine iron fishing rod Chapter 12 Mei Shuangfeng
